en: A black-and-white vintage view of a wooden railway-station style building with ornate trim and a steep tiled roof. Several posters and signs are attached to the walls, and a couple of people stand or sit in front. Bushes and a tall flagpole rise on the right. The caption at the top left reads "Brumunddalen St." and a sign on the building itself reads "Brumunddalen." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century postcard photograph.
